rows.grounds: object of request; sandhi form of mantrān
first member of compound with pūrvān
second member qualifying mantras as preceded by rule
imperative request addressed to the speaker
relative compound with ablative sense; sandhi before jayaḥ

items.question: Which rule-preceded mantras grant victory through their practice?
premises: Those mantras are to be given together with their rules.
The practice of those mantras leads to victory.
items.inference: The requested teaching must identify the mantras, their prescribed procedure, and their victorious efficacy.
uncertainties: The exact scope of vidhi is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Tell me those mantras together with their rules, by whose practice victory is attained.
